correctness.rationale: The published deck matrix is replayed on the standard Picard lattice. Exact exhaustive enumeration finds all 27 line classes, 135 intersecting pairs, and 45 tritangent triples. Projection to the nine deck cycles gives exactly 9 singleton blocks and 12 three-point blocks of multiplicity 3; the latter cover all 36 pairs exactly once. The deck action on tritangents has 9 fixed points and 12 cycles of length 3. Combined with the source flex correspondence and order-648 affine monodromy, this proves the stated \(9+36\) monodromy decomposition and stabilizers.

value.rationale: Tritangent planes are a canonical finite configuration of a cubic surface. The result completes the source line-level cyclic-cover picture by showing that the Hesse affine plane controls all 45 tritangents: nine fixed flex planes plus a natural three-sheeted lift of its twelve affine lines. This gives a structural, parameter-independent family-monodromy invariant rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
